ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your experience did not match your expectations. We are happy to help. 

There are a few things we'd like to go over regarding your igniter. 
 
Do all the burners light fine manually with a lighter or a match? If so, does the grill get up to temperature fine with all burners on high and the lid closed?
Did you verify the electrode is correctly in place and flush with the left burner?

Regarding the trouble with your burners running hot.
 
If you have not recently, we suggest giving your burners a thorough cleaning. If the holes are clogged, that could lead to a number of issues including this one. 
 
Please check out the following info for some tips on cleaning the burner tubes.
 
1. Make sure the grill is completely cooled before removing the grates. (For larger gas grills, be sure to remove your flavorizer bars as well) 
2. Use a clean Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush to gently brush the burner tubes in a side-to-side motion to remove any grease build-up and debris.
3. Avoid brushing lengthwise down the burner tube in order to prevent brushing grease back into the portholes.
 
For the best results use a Weber Detailing Brush.

We do see that our team is already working with you regarding the Left hand side lower panel.
 
Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
